Unfussy, authentic & SO good!
Jun 2026 • Couples
Our first dinner in Hanoi and if the location hadn't been a 30-minute Grab ride away from the Old Quarter, we certainly would have been there for dinner another time.

We had the ribs (in an incredibly intense, deep dark sauce - fantastic!), the banana blossom salad (the best of our stay in Vietnam), and chicken in tamarind (?) sauce: everything fresh, surprising, and very, very good. Friendly, competent service and a nice ambiance round off the evening.

A gem of a restaurant in the West Lake district
Feb 2026 • Couples
This restaurant already has stellar reviews and it deserves them all. The food choices were interesting and delicious, the service was excellent and the ambience very agreeable. It was a place where we felt encouraged to try things we had not eaten before. The crab spring rolls were the best I have ever tasted, with a wonderfully fine and crispy exterior and a very crabby filling, and the sour broth with fish was delicious. My wife had clams in a wonderfully fragrant lemongrass broth, and then barbecued sturgeon. Highly recommended, best restaurant we encountered during our brief visit to Hanoi. It will not be the last!
